entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Cajigal de la Vega was a Spanish Army officer and colonial administrator who served as governor of Cuba from 1747 to 1760, and interim viceroy of New Spain, from April 28, 1760 to October 5, 1760, succeeded by Viceroy Joaquín de Montserrat, marqués de Cruillas.
